_comment: Title and search description for each fixed page. Read by the app (lib/pageMeta.ts, for the browser tab) and by scripts/prerender.mjs (for the index.html it writes per page). Division, airline and airport pages build theirs from the data. {airlines} and {divisions} are filled in with the live counts when the site is published.
